PowerShell dans NeoDex · tape une comman: PowerShell in NeoDex · type a command then Enter (↑ ↓: history). Full screen programs (vim, interactive ssh, etc.) do not work here.
Rien : l'historique des commandes ne dur: Nothing: the command history only lasts for the session.
Une console PowerShell, Invite de comman: A PowerShell, Command Prompt or Git Bash console in a NeoDex tab: one command per line, a prompt that follows the current folder, errors in red, the last 100 commands with the arrow keys, and a Restart button that also stops a stuck command. Full-screen programs such as vim do not work here; nothing is stored. Shell picker in the bar: PowerShell, Command Prompt or Git Bash (if installed), kept from one time to the next; Tab completes the command, path or parameter and shows the list when there are several choices; text and margins follow the screen size. The shell picker needs NeoDex 3.1.16 (before, PowerShell only).
